verses.he: וְזֹ֥את תֹּורַ֖ת הָאָשָׁ֑ם קֹ֥דֶשׁ קֽ͏ָדָשִׁ֖ים הֽוּא׃
verses.ar: «وَهَذِهِ شَرِيعَةُ ذَبِيحَةِ ٱلْإِثْمِ: إِنَّهَا قُدْسُ أَقْدَاسٍ.
verses.en: And this is the law of the guilt-offering: it is most holy.
verses.kjv: Likewise this [is] the law of the trespass offering: it [is] most holy.
verses.web: “‘This is the law of the trespass offering: It is most holy.

verses.he: בִּמְקֹ֗ום אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁחֲטוּ֙ אֶת־הָ֣עֹלָ֔ה יִשְׁחֲט֖וּ אֶת־הָאָשָׁ֑ם וְאֶת־דָּמֹ֛ו יִזְרֹ֥ק עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.ar: فِي ٱلْمَكَانِ ٱلَّذِي يَذْبَحُونَ فِيهِ ٱلْمُحْرَقَةَ، يَذْبَحُونَ ذَبِيحَةَ ٱلْإِثْمِ، وَيَرُشُّ دَمَهَا عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ مُسْتَدِيرًا،
verses.en: In the place where they kill the burnt-offering shall they kill the guilt-offering: and the blood thereof shall be dashed against the altar round about.
verses.kjv: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering: and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar.
verses.web: In the place where they kill the burnt offering, he shall kill the trespass offering; and its blood he shall sprinkle around on the altar.

verses.he: וְאֵ֥ת כָּל־חֶלְבֹּ֖ו יַקְרִ֣יב מִמֶּ֑נּוּ אֵ֚ת הָֽאַלְיָ֔ה וְאֶת־הַחֵ֖לֶב הַֽמְכַסֶּ֥ה אֶת־הַקֶּֽרֶב׃
verses.ar: وَيُقَرِّبُ مِنْهَا كُلَّ شَحْمِهَا: ٱلْأَلْيَةَ، وَٱلشَّحْمَ ٱلَّذِي يُغَشِّي ٱلْأَحْشَاءَ،
verses.en: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof: the fat tail, and the fat that covereth the inwards,
verses.kjv: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof; the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards,
verses.web: He shall offer all of its fat: the fat tail, and the fat that covers the innards,

verses.he: וְאֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְאֶת־הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־הַכְּסָלִ֑ים וְאֶת־הַיֹּתֶ֙רֶת֙ עַל־הַכָּבֵ֔ד עַל־הַכְּלָיֹ֖ת יְסִירֶֽנָּה׃
verses.ar: وَٱلْكُلْيَتَيْنِ وَٱلشَّحْمَ ٱلَّذِي عَلَيْهِمَا، ٱلَّذِي عَلَى ٱلْخَاصِرَتَيْنِ، وَزِيَادَةَ ٱلْكَبِدِ مَعَ ٱلْكُلْيَتَيْنِ يَنْزِعُهَا.
verses.en: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the lobe above the liver, which he shall take away by the kidneys.
verses.kjv: And the two kidneys, and the fat that [is] on them, which [is] by the flanks, and the caul [that is] above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away:
verses.web: and he shall take away the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys;

verses.he: וְהִקְטִ֨יר אֹתָ֤ם הַכֹּהֵן֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה אָשָׁ֖ם הֽוּא׃
verses.ar: وَيُوقِدُهُنَّ ٱلْكَاهِنُ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ وَقُودًا لِلرَّبِّ. إِنَّهَا ذَبِيحَةُ إِثْمٍ.
verses.en: And the priest shall make them smoke upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto the LORD; it is a guilt-offering.
verses.kjv: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar [for] an offering made by fire unto the LORD: it [is] a trespass offering.
verses.web: and the priest shall burn them on the altar for an offering made by fire to Yahweh: it is a trespass offering.

verses.he: כָּל־זָכָ֥ר בַּכֹּהֲנִ֖ים יֹאכְלֶ֑נּוּ בְּמָקֹ֤ום קָדֹושׁ֙ יֵאָכֵ֔ל קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים הֽוּא׃
verses.ar: كُلُّ ذَكَرٍ مِنَ ٱلْكَهَنَةِ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا. فِي مَكَانٍ مُقَدَّسٍ تُؤْكَلُ. إِنَّهَا قُدْسُ أَقْدَاسٍ.
verses.en: Every male among the priests may eat thereof; it shall be eaten in a holy place; it is most holy.
verses.kjv: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in the holy place: it [is] most holy.
verses.web: Every male among the priests may eat of it. It shall be eaten in a holy place. It is most holy.

verses.he: כַּֽחַטָּאת֙ כָּֽאָשָׁ֔ם תֹּורָ֥ה אַחַ֖ת לָהֶ֑ם הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְכַפֶּר־בֹּ֖ו לֹ֥ו יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.ar: ذَبِيحَةُ ٱلْإِثْمِ كَذَبِيحَةِ ٱلْخَطِيَّةِ، لَهُمَا شَرِيعَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ. الْكَاهِنُ ٱلَّذِي يُكَفِّرُ بِهَا تَكُونُ لَهُ.
verses.en: As is the sin-offering, so is the guilt-offering; there is one law for them; the priest that maketh atonement therewith, he shall have it.
verses.kjv: As the sin offering [is], so [is] the trespass offering: [there is] one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have [it].
verses.web: “‘As is the sin offering, so is the trespass offering; there is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with them shall have it.

verses.he: וְהַ֨כֹּהֵ֔ן הַמַּקְרִ֖יב אֶת־עֹ֣לַת אִ֑ישׁ עֹ֤ור הָֽעֹלָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִקְרִ֔יב לַכֹּהֵ֖ן לֹ֥ו יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.ar: وَٱلْكَاهِنُ ٱلَّذِي يُقَرِّبُ مُحْرَقَةَ إِنْسَانٍ فَجِلْدُ ٱلْمُحْرَقَةِ ٱلَّتِي يُقَرِّبُهَا يَكُونُ لَهُ.
verses.en: And the priest that offereth any man's burnt-offering, even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt-offering which he hath offered.
verses.kjv: And the priest that offereth any man’s burnt offering, [even] the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered.
verses.web: The priest who offers any man’s burnt offering shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered.

verses.he: וְכָל־מִנְחָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר תֵּֽאָפֶה֙ בַּתַּנּ֔וּר וְכָל־נַעֲשָׂ֥ה בַמַּרְחֶ֖שֶׁת וְעַֽל־מַחֲבַ֑ת לַכֹּהֵ֛ן הַמַּקְרִ֥יב אֹתָ֖הּ לֹ֥ו תִֽהְיֶֽה׃
verses.ar: وَكُلُّ تَقْدِمَةٍ خُبِزَتْ فِي ٱلتَّنُّورِ، وَكُلُّ مَا عُمِلَ فِي طَاجِنٍ أَوْ عَلَى صَاجٍ يَكُونُ لِلْكَاهِنِ ٱلَّذِي يُقَرِّبُهُ.
verses.en: And every meal-offering that is baked in the oven, and all that is dressed in the stewing-pan, and on the griddle, shall be the priest's that offereth it.
verses.kjv: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the fryingpan, and in the pan, shall be the priest’s that offereth it.
verses.web: Every meal offering that is baked in the oven, and all that is prepared in the pan and on the griddle, shall be the priest’s who offers it.

verses.he: וְכָל־מִנְחָ֥ה בְלוּלָֽה־בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן וַחֲרֵבָ֑ה לְכָל־בְּנֵ֧י אַהֲרֹ֛ן תִּהְיֶ֖ה אִ֥ישׁ כְּאָחִֽיו׃ פ
verses.ar: وَكُلُّ تَقْدِمَةٍ مَلْتُوتَةٍ بِزَيْتٍ أَوْ نَاشِفَةٍ تَكُونُ لِجَمِيعِ بَنِي هَارُونَ، كُلِّ إِنْسَانٍ كَأَخِيهِ.
verses.en: And every meal-offering, mingled with oil, or dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one as well as another.
verses.kjv: And every meat offering, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one [as much] as another.
verses.web: Every meal offering, mixed with oil or dry, belongs to all the sons of Aaron, one as well as another.

verses.he: וְזֹ֥את תֹּורַ֖ת זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַקְרִ֖יב לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: «وَهَذِهِ شَرِيعَةُ ذَبِيحَةِ ٱلسَّلَامَةِ. ٱلَّذِي يُقَرِّبُهَا لِلرَّبِّ:
verses.en: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace-offerings, which one may offer unto the LORD.
verses.kjv: And this [is] the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he shall offer unto the LORD.
verses.web: “‘This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which one shall offer to Yahweh:

verses.he: אִ֣ם עַל־תֹּודָה֮ יַקְרִיבֶנּוּ֒ וְהִקְרִ֣יב ׀ עַל־זֶ֣בַח הַתֹּודָ֗ה חַלֹּ֤ות מַצֹּות֙ בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּשֶּׁ֔מֶן וּרְקִיקֵ֥י מַצֹּ֖ות מְשֻׁחִ֣ים בַּשָּׁ֑מֶן וְסֹ֣לֶת מֻרְבֶּ֔כֶת חַלֹּ֖ת בְּלוּלֹ֥ת בַּשָּֽׁמֶן׃
verses.ar: إِنْ قَرَّبَهَا لِأَجْلِ ٱلشُّكْرِ، يُقَرِّبُ عَلَى ذَبِيحَةِ ٱلشُّكْرِ أَقْرَاصَ فَطِيرٍ مَلْتُوتَةً بِزَيْتٍ، وَرِقَاقَ فَطِيرٍ مَدْهُونَةً بِزَيْتٍ، وَدَقِيقًا مَرْبُوكًا أَقْرَاصًا مَلْتُوتَةً بِزَيْتٍ،
verses.en: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers spread with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour soaked.
verses.kjv: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.
verses.web: If he offers it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mixed with oil.

verses.he: עַל־חַלֹּת֙ לֶ֣חֶם חָמֵ֔ץ יַקְרִ֖יב קָרְבָּנֹ֑ו עַל־זֶ֖בַח תֹּודַ֥ת שְׁלָמָֽיו׃
verses.ar: مَعَ أَقْرَاصِ خُبْزٍ خَمِيرٍ يُقَرِّبُ قُرْبَانَهُ عَلَى ذَبِيحَةِ شُكْرِ سَلَامَتِهِ.
verses.en: With cakes of leavened bread he shall present his offering with the sacrifice of his peace-offerings for thanksgiving.
verses.kjv: Besides the cakes, he shall offer [for] his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.
verses.web: He shall offer his offering with the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving with cakes of leavened bread.

verses.he: וְהִקְרִ֨יב מִמֶּ֤נּוּ אֶחָד֙ מִכָּל־קָרְבָּ֔ן תְּרוּמָ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה לַכֹּהֵ֗ן הַזֹּרֵ֛ק אֶת־דַּ֥ם הַשְּׁלָמִ֖ים לֹ֥ו יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.ar: وَيُقَرِّبُ مِنْهُ وَاحِدًا مِنْ كُلِّ قُرْبَانٍ رَفِيعَةً لِلرَّبِّ، يَكُونُ لِلْكَاهِنِ ٱلَّذِي يَرُشُّ دَمَ ذَبِيحَةِ ٱلسَّلَامَةِ.
verses.en: And of it he shall present one out of each offering for a gift unto the LORD; it shall be the priest's that dasheth the blood of the peace-offerings against the altar.
verses.kjv: And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation [for] an heave offering unto the LORD, [and] it shall be the priest’s that sprinkleth the blood of the peace offerings.
verses.web: Of it he shall offer one out of each offering for a heave offering to Yahweh. It shall be the priest’s who sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings.

verses.he: וּבְשַׂ֗ר זֶ֚בַח תֹּודַ֣ת שְׁלָמָ֔יו בְּיֹ֥ום קָרְבָּנֹ֖ו יֵאָכֵ֑ל לֹֽא־יַנִּ֥יחַ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עַד־בֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.ar: وَلَحْمُ ذَبِيحَةِ شُكْرِ سَلَامَتِهِ يُؤْكَلُ يَوْمَ قُرْبَانِهِ. لَا يُبْقِي مِنْهُ شَيْئًا إِلَى ٱلصَّبَاحِ.
verses.en: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace-offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his offering; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.
verses.kjv: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.
verses.web: The flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his offering. He shall not leave any of it until the morning.

verses.he: וְאִם־נֶ֣דֶר ׀ אֹ֣ו נְדָבָ֗ה זֶ֚בַח קָרְבָּנֹ֔ו בְּיֹ֛ום הַקְרִיבֹ֥ו אֶת־זִבְחֹ֖ו יֵאָכֵ֑ל וּמִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת וְהַנֹּותָ֥ר מִמֶּ֖נּוּ יֵאָכֵֽל׃
verses.ar: وَإِنْ كَانَتْ ذَبِيحَةُ قُرْبَانِهِ نَذْرًا أَوْ نَافِلَةً، فَفِي يَوْمِ تَقْرِيبِهِ ذَبِيحَتَهُ تُؤْكَلُ. وَفِي ٱلْغَدِ يُؤْكَلُ مَا فَضَلَ مِنْهَا.
verses.en: But if the sacrifice of his offering be a vow, or a freewill-offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he offereth his sacrifice; and on the morrow that which remaineth of it may be eaten.
verses.kjv: But if the sacrifice of his offering [be] a vow, or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice: and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten:
verses.web: “‘But if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow, or a free will offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he offers his sacrifice. On the next day what remains of it shall be eaten,

verses.he: וְהַנֹּותָ֖ר מִבְּשַׂ֣ר הַזָּ֑בַח בַּיֹּום֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י בָּאֵ֖שׁ יִשָּׂרֵֽף׃
verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلْفَاضِلُ مِنْ لَحْمِ ٱلذَّبِيحَةِ فِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلثَّالِثِ فَيُحْرَقُ بِٱلنَّارِ.
verses.en: But that which remaineth of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.
verses.kjv: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.
verses.web: but what remains of the meat of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire.

verses.he: וְאִ֣ם הֵאָכֹ֣ל יֵ֠אָכֵל מִבְּשַׂר־זֶ֨בַח שְׁלָמָ֜יו בַּיֹּ֣ום הַשְּׁלִישִׁי֮ לֹ֣א יֵרָצֶה֒ הַמַּקְרִ֣יב אֹתֹ֗ו לֹ֧א יֵחָשֵׁ֛ב לֹ֖ו פִּגּ֣וּל יִהְיֶ֑ה וְהַנֶּ֛פֶשׁ הָאֹכֶ֥לֶת מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עֲוֹנָ֥הּ תִּשָּֽׂא׃
verses.ar: وَإِنْ أُكِلَ مِنْ لَحْمِ ذَبِيحَةِ سَلَامَتِهِ فِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلثَّالِثِ لَا تُقْبَلُ. ٱلَّذِي يُقَرِّبُهَا لَا تُحْسَبُ لَهُ، تَكُونُ نَجَاسَةً، وَٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلَّتِي تَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا تَحْمِلُ ذَنْبَهَا.
verses.en: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace-offerings be at all eaten on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it; it shall be an abhorred thing, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.
verses.kjv: And if [any] of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.
verses.web: If any of the meat of the sacrifice of his peace offerings is eaten on the third day, it will not be accepted, and it shall not be credited to him who offers it. It will be an abomination, and the soul who eats any of it will bear his iniquity.

verses.he: וְהַבָּשָׂ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־יִגַּ֤ע בְּכָל־טָמֵא֙ לֹ֣א יֵֽאָכֵ֔ל בָּאֵ֖שׁ יִשָּׂרֵ֑ף וְהַ֨בָּשָׂ֔ר כָּל־טָהֹ֖ור יֹאכַ֥ל בָּשָֽׂר׃
verses.ar: وَٱللَّحْمُ ٱلَّذِي مَسَّ شَيْئًا مَا نَجِسًا لَا يُؤْكَلُ. يُحْرَقُ بِٱلنَّارِ. وَٱللَّحْمُ يَأْكُلُ كُلُّ طَاهِرٍ مِنْهُ.
verses.en: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire. And as for the flesh, every one that is clean may eat thereof.
verses.kjv: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean [thing] shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire: and as for the flesh, all that be clean shall eat thereof.
verses.web: “‘The meat that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten. It shall be burned with fire. As for the meat, everyone who is clean may eat it;

verses.he: וְהַנֶּ֜פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־תֹּאכַ֣ל בָּשָׂ֗ר מִזֶּ֤בַח הַשְּׁלָמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַיהוָ֔ה וְטֻמְאָתֹ֖ו עָלָ֑יו וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵעַמֶּֽיהָ׃
verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلَّتِي تَأْكُلُ لَحْمًا مِنْ ذَبِيحَةِ ٱلسَّلَامَةِ ٱلَّتِي لِلرَّبِّ وَنَجَاسَتُهَا عَلَيْهَا فَتُقْطَعُ تِلْكَ ٱلنَّفْسُ مِنْ شَعْبِهَا.
verses.en: But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace-offerings, that pertain unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.kjv: But the soul that eateth [of] the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that [pertain] unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.web: but the soul who eats of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings that belongs to Yahweh, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from his people.

verses.he: וְנֶ֜פֶשׁ כִּֽי־תִגַּ֣ע בְּכָל־טָמֵ֗א בְּטֻמְאַ֤ת אָדָם֙ אֹ֣ו ׀ בִּבְהֵמָ֣ה טְמֵאָ֗ה אֹ֚ו בְּכָל־שֶׁ֣קֶץ טָמֵ֔א וְאָכַ֛ל מִבְּשַׂר־זֶ֥בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַיהוָ֑ה וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵעַמֶּֽיהָ׃ פ
verses.ar: وَٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلَّتِي تَمَسُّ شَيْئًا مَّا نَجِسًا نَجَاسَةَ إِنْسَانٍ أَوْ بَهِيمَةً نَجِسَةً أَوْ مَكْرُوهًا مَّا نَجِسًا، ثُمَّ تَأْكُلُ مِنْ لَحْمِ ذَبِيحَةِ ٱلسَّلَامَةِ ٱلَّتِي لِلرَّبِّ، تُقْطَعُ تِلْكَ ٱلنَّفْسُ مِنْ شَعْبِهَا».
verses.en: And when any one shall touch any unclean thing, whether it be the uncleanness of man, or an unclean beast, or any unclean detestable thing, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace-offerings, which pertain unto the LORD, that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.kjv: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean [thing, as] the uncleanness of man, or [any] unclean beast, or any abominable unclean [thing], and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which [pertain] unto the LORD, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.web: When anyone touches any unclean thing, the uncleanness of man, or an unclean animal, or any unclean abomination, and eats some of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings which belong to Yahweh, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”

verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.ar: وَكَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى قَائِلًا:
verses.en: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.kjv: ¶ And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.he: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר כָּל־חֵ֜לֶב שֹׁ֥ור וְכֶ֛שֶׂב וָעֵ֖ז לֹ֥א תֹאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.ar: «كَلِّمْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ قَائِلًا: كُلَّ شَحْمِ ثَوْرٍ أَوْ كَبْشٍ أَوْ مَاعِزٍ لَا تَأْكُلُوا.
verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying: Ye shall eat no fat, of ox, or sheep, or goat.
verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.
verses.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘You shall eat no fat, of bull, or sheep, or goat.

verses.he: וְחֵ֤לֶב נְבֵלָה֙ וְחֵ֣לֶב טְרֵפָ֔ה יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה לְכָל־מְלָאכָ֑ה וְאָכֹ֖ל לֹ֥א תֹאכְלֻֽהוּ׃
verses.ar: وَأَمَّا شَحْمُ ٱلْمَيْتَةِ وَشَحْمُ ٱلْمُفْتَرَسَةِ فَيُسْتَعْمَلُ لِكُلِّ عَمَلٍ، لَكِنْ أَكْلًا لَا تَأْكُلُوهُ.
verses.en: And the fat of that which dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn of beasts, may be used for any other service; but ye shall in no wise eat of it.
verses.kjv: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn with beasts, may be used in any other use: but ye shall in no wise eat of it.
verses.web: The fat of that which dies of itself, and the fat of that which is torn of animals, may be used for any other service, but you shall in no way eat of it.

verses.he: כִּ֚י כָּל־אֹכֵ֣ל חֵ֔לֶב מִן־הַ֨בְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַקְרִ֥יב מִמֶּ֛נָּה אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הָאֹכֶ֖לֶת מֵֽעַמֶּֽיהָ׃
verses.ar: إِنَّ كُلَّ مَنْ أَكَلَ شَحْمًا مِنَ ٱلْبَهَائِمِ ٱلَّتِي يُقَرِّبُ مِنْهَا وَقُودًا لِلرَّبِّ تُقْطَعُ مِنْ شَعْبِهَا، ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلَّتِي تَأْكُلُ.
verses.en: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men present an offering made by fire unto the LORD, even the soul that eateth it shall be cut off from his people.
verses.kjv: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD, even the soul that eateth [it] shall be cut off from his people.
verses.web: For whoever eats the fat of the animal which men offer as an offering made by fire to Yahweh, even the soul who eats it shall be cut off from his people.

verses.he: וְכָל־דָּם֙ לֹ֣א תֹאכְל֔וּ בְּכֹ֖ל מֹושְׁבֹתֵיכֶ֑ם לָעֹ֖וף וְלַבְּהֵמָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَكُلَّ دَمٍ لَا تَأْكُلُوا فِي جَمِيعِ مَسَاكِنِكُمْ مِنَ ٱلطَّيْرِ وَمِنَ ٱلْبَهَائِمِ.
verses.en: And ye shall eat no manner of blood, whether it be of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.
verses.kjv: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood, [whether it be] of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.
verses.web: You shall not eat any blood, whether it is of bird or of animal, in any of your dwellings.

verses.he: כָּל־נֶ֖פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־תֹּאכַ֣ל כָּל־דָּ֑ם וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵֽעַמֶּֽיהָ׃ פ
verses.ar: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ تَأْكُلُ شَيْئًا مِنَ ٱلدَّمِ تُقْطَعُ تِلْكَ ٱلنَّفْسُ مِنْ شَعْبِهَا».
verses.en: Whosoever it be that eateth any blood, that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.kjv: Whatsoever soul [it be] that eateth any manner of blood, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.web: Whoever it is who eats any blood, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”

verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.ar: وَكَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى قَائِلًا:
verses.en: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.kjv: ¶ And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.he: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר הַמַּקְרִ֞יב אֶת־זֶ֤בַח שְׁלָמָיו֙ לַיהוָ֔ה יָבִ֧יא אֶת־קָרְבָּנֹ֛ו לַיהוָ֖ה מִזֶּ֥בַח שְׁלָמָֽיו׃
verses.ar: «كَلِّمْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ قَائِلًا: ٱلَّذِي يُقَرِّبُ ذَبِيحَةَ سَلَامَتِهِ لِلرَّبِّ، يَأْتِي بِقُرْبَانِهِ إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ مِنْ ذَبِيحَةِ سَلَامَتِهِ.
verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying: He that offereth his sacrifice of peace-offerings unto the LORD shall bring his offering unto the LORD out of his sacrifice of peace-offerings.
verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace offerings unto the LORD shall bring his oblation unto the LORD of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.
verses.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘He who offers the sacrifice of his peace offerings to Yahweh shall bring his offering to Yahweh out of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.

verses.he: יָדָ֣יו תְּבִיאֶ֔ינָה אֵ֖ת אִשֵּׁ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֶת־הַחֵ֤לֶב עַל־הֶֽחָזֶה֙ יְבִיאֶ֔נּוּ אֵ֣ת הֶחָזֶ֗ה לְהָנִ֥יף אֹתֹ֛ו תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: يَدَاهُ تَأْتِيَانِ بِوَقَائِدِ ٱلرَّبِّ. ٱلشَّحْمُ يَأْتِي بِهِ مَعَ ٱلصَّدْرِ. أَمَّا ٱلصَّدْرُ فَلِكَيْ يُرَدِّدَهُ تَرْدِيدًا أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: His own hands shall bring the offerings of the LORD made by fire: the fat with the breast shall he bring, that the breast may be waved for a wave-offering before the LORD.
verses.kjv: His own hands shall bring the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the fat with the breast, it shall he bring, that the breast may be waved [for] a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.web: With his own hands he shall bring the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. He shall bring the fat with the breast, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before Yahweh.

verses.he: וְהִקְטִ֧יר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־הַחֵ֖לֶב הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה וְהָיָה֙ הֶֽחָזֶ֔ה לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָֽיו׃
verses.ar: فَيُوقِدُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ ٱلشَّحْمَ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ، وَيَكُونُ ٱلصَّدْرُ لِهَارُونَ وَبَنِيهِ.
verses.en: And the priest shall make the fat smoke upon the altar; but the breast shall be Aaron's and his sons'.
verses.kjv: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.
verses.web: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.

verses.he: וְאֵת֙ שֹׁ֣וק הַיָּמִ֔ין תִּתְּנ֥וּ תְרוּמָ֖ה לַכֹּהֵ֑ן מִזִּבְחֵ֖י שַׁלְמֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.ar: وَٱلسَّاقُ ٱلْيُمْنَى تُعْطُونَهَا رَفِيعَةً لِلْكَاهِنِ مِنْ ذَبَائِحِ سَلَامَتِكُمْ.
verses.en: And the right thigh shall ye give unto the priest for a heave-offering out of your sacrifices of peace-offerings.
verses.kjv: And the right shoulder shall ye give unto the priest [for] an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
verses.web: The right thigh you shall give to the priest for a heave offering out of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.

verses.he: הַמַּקְרִ֞יב אֶת־דַּ֧ם הַשְּׁלָמִ֛ים וְאֶת־הַחֵ֖לֶב מִבְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֑ן לֹ֧ו תִהְיֶ֛ה שֹׁ֥וק הַיָּמִ֖ין לְמָנָֽה׃
verses.ar: اَلَّذِي يُقَرِّبُ دَمَ ذَبِيحَةِ ٱلسَّلَامَةِ وَٱلشَّحْمَ مِنْ بَنِي هَارُونَ، تَكُونُ لَهُ ٱلسَّاقُ ٱلْيُمْنَى نَصِيبًا،
verses.en: He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace-offerings, and the fat, shall have the right thigh for a portion.
verses.kjv: He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for [his] part.
verses.web: He among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right thigh for a portion.

verses.he: כִּי֩ אֶת־חֲזֵ֨ה הַתְּנוּפָ֜ה וְאֵ֣ת ׀ שֹׁ֣וק הַתְּרוּמָ֗ה לָקַ֙חְתִּי֙ מֵאֵ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִזִּבְחֵ֖י שַׁלְמֵיהֶ֑ם וָאֶתֵּ֣ן אֹ֠תָם לְאַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֵ֤ן וּלְבָנָיו֙ לְחָק־עֹולָ֔ם מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّ صَدْرَ ٱلتَّرْدِيدِ وَسَاقَ ٱلرَّفِيعَةِ قَدْ أَخَذْتُهُمَا مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مِنْ ذَبَائِحِ سَلَامَتِهِمْ وَأَعْطَيْتُهُمَا لِهَارُونَ ٱلْكَاهِنِ وَلِبَنِيهِ فَرِيضَةً دَهْرِيَّةً مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ».
verses.en: For the breast of waving and the thigh of heaving have I taken of the children of Israel out of their sacrifices of peace-offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons as a due for ever from the children of Israel.
verses.kjv: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel.
verses.web: For the waved breast and the heaved thigh I have taken from the children of Israel out of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel.’”

verses.he: זֹ֣את מִשְׁחַ֤ת אַהֲרֹן֙ וּמִשְׁחַ֣ת בָּנָ֔יו מֵאִשֵּׁ֖י יְהוָ֑ה בְּיֹום֙ הִקְרִ֣יב אֹתָ֔ם לְכַהֵ֖ן לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: تِلْكَ مَسْحَةُ هَارُونَ وَمَسْحَةُ بَنِيهِ مِنْ وَقَائِدِ ٱلرَّبِّ يَوْمَ تَقْدِيمِهِمْ لِيَكْهَنُوا لِلرَّبِّ،
verses.en: This is the consecrated portion of Aaron, and the consecrated portion of his sons, out of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, in the day when they were presented to minister unto the LORD in the priest's office;
verses.kjv: ¶ This [is the portion] of the anointing of Aaron, and of the anointing of his sons, out of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, in the day [when] he presented them to minister unto the LORD in the priest’s office;
verses.web: This is the consecrated portion of Aaron, and the consecrated portion of his sons, out of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister to Yahweh in the priest’s office;

verses.he: אֲשֶׁר֩ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֗ם בְּיֹום֙ מָשְׁחֹ֣ו אֹתָ֔ם מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל חֻקַּ֥ת עֹולָ֖ם לְדֹרֹתָֽם׃
verses.ar: ٱلَّتِي أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ أَنْ تُعْطَى لَهُمْ يَوْمَ مَسْحِهِ إِيَّاهُمْ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ، فَرِيضَةً دَهْرِيَّةً فِي أَجْيَالِهِمْ.
verses.en: which the LORD commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that they were anointed. It is a due for ever throughout their generations.
verses.kjv: Which the LORD commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them, [by] a statute for ever throughout their generations.
verses.web: which Yahweh commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them. It is their portion forever throughout their generations.

verses.he: זֹ֣את הַתֹּורָ֗ה לָֽעֹלָה֙ לַמִּנְחָ֔ה וְלַֽחַטָּ֖את וְלָאָשָׁ֑ם וְלַ֨מִּלּוּאִ֔ים וּלְזֶ֖בַח הַשְּׁלָמִֽים׃
verses.ar: تِلْكَ شَرِيعَةُ ٱلْمُحْرَقَةِ، وَٱلتَّقْدِمَةِ، وَذَبِيحَةِ ٱلْخَطِيَّةِ، وَذَبِيحَةِ ٱلْإِثْمِ، وَذَبِيحَةِ ٱلْمِلْءِ، وَذَبِيحَةِ ٱلسَّلَامَةِ،
verses.en: This is the law of the burnt-offering, of the meal-offering, and of the sin-offering, and of the guilt-offering, and of the consecration-offering, and of the sacrifice of peace-offerings;
verses.kjv: This [is] the law of the burnt offering, of the meat offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings;
verses.web: This is the law of the burnt offering, the meal offering, the sin offering, the trespass offering, the consecration, and the sacrifice of peace offerings

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּהַ֣ר סִינָ֑י בְּיֹ֨ום צַוֹּתֹ֜ו אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לְהַקְרִ֧יב אֶת־קָרְבְּנֵיהֶ֛ם לַיהוָ֖ה בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי׃ פ
verses.ar: ٱلَّتِي أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ بِهَا مُوسَى فِي جَبَلِ سِينَاءَ، يَوْمَ أَمْرِهِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ بِتَقْرِيبِ قَرَابِينِهِمْ لِلرَّبِّ فِي بَرِّيَّةِ سِينَاءَ.
verses.en: which the LORD commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to present their offerings unto the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.kjv: Which the LORD commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.web: which Yahweh commanded Moses in Mount Sinai in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their offerings to Yahweh, in the wilderness of Sinai.
